import sys
from collections import deque

class TaskB:
    @staticmethod
    def solve():
        data = sys.stdin.read().split()
        if not data:
            return
        it = iter(data)
        n = int(next(it))
        m = int(next(it))
        if n > m:
            n, m = m, n
        V = n * m

        if V < 100:
            v = V
            g = [[] for _ in range(v)]
            for i in range(v):
                r1 = i // m
                c1 = i % m
                if ((r1 + c1) & 1) == 0:
                    for j in range(v):
                        r2 = j // m
                        c2 = j % m
                        if abs(r1 - r2) + abs(c1 - c2) == 3:
                            g[i].append(j)
            pairs = TaskB.maxMatching(g, m)
            print(pairs * 2)
        else:
            if n == 1:
                res = (m // 6) * 6
                if m % 6 == 4:
                    res += 2
                if m % 6 == 5:
                    res += 4
            else:
                res = V
                if res % 2 != 0:
                    res -= 1
            print(res)

    @staticmethod
    def maxMatching(g, cols):
        n = len(g)
        matchL = [-1] * n
        matchR = [-1] * n
        pairs = 0
        for u in range(n):
            r = u // cols
            c = u % cols
            if ((r + c) & 1) == 0 and matchL[u] == -1:
                if TaskB.augment(g, u, matchL, matchR):
                    pairs += 1
        return pairs

    @staticmethod
    def augment(g, root, matchL, matchR):
        n = len(g)
        prevL = [-1] * n
        prevR = [-1] * n
        q = deque()
        q.append(root)
        while q:
            u = q.popleft()
            for v in g[u]:
                if prevR[v] != -1:
                    continue
                prevR[v] = u
                if matchR[v] == -1:
                    curR = v
                    while curR != -1:
                        curL = prevR[curR]
                        nextR = matchL[curL]
                        matchL[curL] = curR
                        matchR[curR] = curL
                        curR = nextR
                    return True
                else:
                    nextL = matchR[v]
                    if prevL[nextL] == -1:
                        prevL[nextL] = u
                        q.append(nextL)
        return False

if __name__ == "__main__":
    TaskB.solve()
